difco_evidence_conclusion.primary: Genuine BD Difco & BBL Manual SecondEdition2009 printed158/PDF170, SHAe5e836a75f13283d477467b20ffc0d332531e0f3a0effb5d64a7147a6985c0b7; fullpage visually inspected via exact localPDF raster.
difco_evidence_conclusion.direction: 44g dry product per1L purified water; subsequent blood addition is separate. JCM1270 names44g BD-Difco base and separately50ml sheep blood/950ml water.
difco_evidence_conclusion.nominal_closure: The formula table gives the complete nominal immediate ingredient set. It is not a selective example list; all7 names are represented. No quantitative parts are introduced by this recommendation.
difco_evidence_conclusion.footnote: Adjustment/supplementation as required limits actual batch identity/composition; it does not itself prove parts omitted from the stated nominal seven-input formula. Preserve the variability qualification and actual historical JCM-lot unknown.
difco_evidence_conclusion.quantitative_gap: Unspecified ratios in current components or unresolved term IDs do not make constituent-name closure PARTIAL. The schema separates method, parts, quantities, completeness and grounding.
difco_evidence_conclusion.not_approved: No conversion to exact dry mass fractions, exact historical lot composition, BBL/EH identity, new global aliases or maintained mixed-Columbia ownership partition.

evidence.source_record: BD Difco & BBL Manual, Second Edition (2009), Columbia Agars, printed page158 / PDF page170
evidence.notes: Recovered manufacturer-authored BD Difco & BBL Manual, second edition 2009, printed p158 (PDF page170), hosted by NMSU. Original capture 2026-11-08T06:55:09.048187+00:00, SHA256 e5e836a75f13283d477467b20ffc0d332531e0f3a0effb5d64a7147a6985c0b7. The approximate per-liter Difco table lists pancreatic digest of casein10g, Proteose Peptone No.3 5g, yeast extract5g, beef heart infusion from500g 3g, corn starch1g, sodium chloride5g and agar15g; the footnote allows adjustment/supplementation to meet performance criteria. It directs suspension of44g powder in1L purified water. Those are manufacturer preparation/formula statements, not dry-product mass fractions, final yield, or an identified historical JCM lot. The same page separately gives BBL42.5g (including13.5g agar, meat peptic digest and heart pancreatic digest) and DifcoEH39g (including12g agar and different nutrient inputs). The older mirrored manual has different heart wording and BBL proportions and is retained as separate version context. The old search wrapper and failed official/mirror requests remain historical leads, not primary manual evidence.

current_assertion.notes: Seven named constituents only, scoped to the nominal 2009 Difco manufacturer formulation. PARTIAL is retained for the source-qualified JCM1270 input: exact historical lot and any performance-related adjustments are unverified. No blood or reconstitution water is a dry-base component.

current_assertion.notes: No percentage, molarity, aqueous solvent, supplier, grade, excipients or exact equivalence between source lots is established. This bounded qualitative preparation supports source association only; quantitative stock reconstruction and equivalence to a specified acid product remain unapproved. Source-named parts remain UNMAPPED where supplied form or stock identity is not established. MIM_CATALOG references identify only the supported constituent, not approval of that complete owner. Literal 25%, 32% and 35% are retained as source specifications, not normalized comparable fractions. The cited sources do not state a common percentage basis, carrier, grade or assay tolerance; the exact same-or-distinct preparation relation is unresolved. TOGO M2305/M2746 explicitly calls its 25% input concentrated, so that qualitative label does not exclude a numerical percentage. If comparable definitions and assay ranges were established, a real strength difference could be assessed; they are not established here. Before co-installing overlapping candidates, the coordinator must choose an explicit common bounded partial-material scope preserving every source context, or obtain comparable preparation/product evidence. No owner merge or arbitrary winner is selected.
